tools.name: Browser Bridge
tools.description: Share clipboards, files, and messages directly between devices through your browser. No downloads, no accounts - just secure peer-to-peer connections using WebRTC technology.

tools.name: Image Editor
tools.description: Fast and lightweight image manipulation tool with resize, crop, rotate, effects, and format conversion. All processing happens in your browser - no data is sent to any server. Supports various import and export formats and metadata inspection (EXIF, IPTC, XMP, ICC).
tools.heroExtra: Wide format browser or tablet recommended for best editing experience.

tools.name: Barcode Generator
tools.description: Generate QR codes, barcodes, and 2D codes with customization options. Adjust colors, transparencies, sizes, and save to common file formats like PNG or SVG. Supports popular formats including Code 128, Data Matrix, and postal codes.

tools.name: Data Workbench
tools.description: Browser-based BI tool powered by DuckDB for CSV, JSON, Parquet, and Excel files. Convert between formats, adjust delimiters, run SQL queries, and analyze data entirely in your browser. All processing happens locally - no data leaves your browser.
tools.heroExtra:
Supports CSV ⇄ JSON ⇄ Parquet ⇄ Excel conversions with advanced SQL analytics. Features auto-schema detection, statistics generation, full-text search, and a complete SQL console for complex queries. Powered by DuckDB extensions: excel, fts, json, parquet.

For SQL help and advanced queries, see the DuckDB documentation.

tools.name: JSON Utilities
tools.description: Clean, format, validate JSON data with intelligent processing. Repairs malformed JSON, removes comments and fixes quotes, and prettifies formatting.
tools.heroExtra: Clean removes comments, fixes quotes, handles MongoDB syntax, and repairs malformed JSON. If validation or formatting fails, try using Clean first to fix syntax errors.

tools.name: Diff Utilities
tools.description: Compare two sets of text, JSON, CSS, and array data with visual diff highlighting. See additions, deletions, and changes side-by-side with intelligent semantic comparison.

tools.name: UUID Generator
tools.description: Generate secure UUIDs and unique identifiers instantly using browser crypto APIs. Perfect for developers needing fast database keys, session IDs, or unique reference numbers.

tools.name: Passphrase Generator
tools.description: Create memorable yet secure passphrases using natural language patterns or random character sequences. Customizable length and complexity for any security requirement. Fast and simple.

tools.name: Hash Generator
tools.description: Generate cryptographic hashes and checksums using algorithms like SHA-256, MD5, SHA-3, and more. Perfect for data integrity verification, quick troubleshooting, and security applications.
